scripts.build: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:docs && npm test
scripts.format: prettier --write shared server src/workspace scripts tests/backend tests/*.spec.ts tests/helpers
scripts.format:check: prettier --check shared server src/workspace scripts tests/backend tests/*.spec.ts tests/helpers
